chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Set out, and sustenance will set out for you.

key_terms.الرِّزْقُ: Sustenance, provision, or livelihood granted by Allah
key_terms.اِشْخَصْ: Set out; depart or go forth in order to pursue a matter
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam
key_terms.يَشْخَصْ: Will set out or move forth toward you

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام encourage seeking sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages initiative in seeking livelihood rather than remaining idle. It teaches that by setting out and making effort, a person opens the way for rizq to come to him by Allah's permission.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3572 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Set out (on a journey), and sustenance will set out for you."
